Rotate into ORCL and 9988 for defensive AI-cloud exposure; avoid chasing 2454 after its +10% pop. Trim DIVA into strength.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US AI data-center power demand is structurally re-rating independent power producers and solar-plus-storage names, creating durable outperformance versus Indonesian utilities tied to slower PLN dispat
Indonesian geothermal remains the most bankable climate-tech sub-sector due to state-backed offtake and World Bank funding, but project timelines hinge on permitting reform that is not yet priced in.
Global solar module oversupply is compressing margins for Indonesian manufacturers, pushing value toward downstream O&M and battery integration rather than upstream production.
sectors.ai: US-listed renewables names are leading on policy momentum and AI-driven power demand, while Indonesian exposure lags on domestic regulatory friction. Rotate into US solar and storage names (FSLR, SEDG, ENPH) for near-term beta, but build Indonesian positions selectively around geothermal and biomass where tariffs and PPAs are stabilizing. Trim pure-play Indonesian EPCs until clarity on PLN procurement emerges.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Regulatory stability and food-security policies are creating a supportive backdrop for domestic consumer manufacturers, reducing input-cost volatility and boosting margin predictability.
sectors.ai: Buy selective mid-cap FMCG names with confirmed volume breakouts (JELI, IATA, BACH) while avoiding large-cap laggards; the sector's mild aggregate gain masks strong rotational momentum into smaller consumer plays. Position for 2-4 week continuation as US-listed peers (+0.46%) confirm demand, but trim into any 15%+ single-day spikes to lock gains.
